trap.label: há × tem
trap.wrong: Has a cat in the garden.
trap.right: There is a cat in the garden.
trap.why: Em português "tem" coloquial indica existência; em inglês existência exige there is/are e não have.

mcq.q: Short answer: Is there a park? ___

fix.wrong: It is a park near my house.
fix.right: There is a park near my house.
There is a bank near here.

rewrite.prompt: Faça pergunta: “There is a bank here.”
Negue com there isn’t: “There is a park here.”
Reescreva com there is: “A dog is in the garden.”
rewrite.answer: There is a dog in the garden.
